mapper.select: /*selectBuyerWmGrWarehousingLisSlogic*/ SELECT X.BUYER , DECODE(Y.BUYER, NULL, 'N', 'Y') AS ROW_CNT_YN --그리드 행개수 , DECODE(Y.BUYER, NULL, 10, Y.ROW_CNT) AS ROW_CNT --그리드 default 개수 , DECODE(V.BUYER, NULL, 'N', 'Y') AS CARD_YN --신용카드 사용고객사 , NVL(W.DEPT_FIX, 'N') AS DEPT_FIX --요청부서 조건 고정 , NVL(W.PR_USER_FIX, 'N') AS PR_USER_FIX --발주자로 조건 고정 , NVL(W.PO_USER_FIX, 'N') AS PO_USER_FIX --요청자로 조건 고정 , DECODE(A.BUYER, NULL, NULL, A.BTN_TEXT) AS EXTR_REPORT_BTN --추가리포트버튼 , DECODE(A.BUYER, NULL, NULL, A.REPORT_ID) AS EXTR_REPORT_ID --추가리포트아이디 , DECODE(B.BUYER, NULL, 'N', 'Y') AS CLSD_DNLD_YN --[마감다운로드](버튼) 기능 FROM ( SELECT #{com_code} AS BUYER --SESSION COMCODE FROM DUAL ) X , ( /* SLOGIC-BEGIN(P07-0000004) 그리드 출력 초기 rowcount 100 (default rowcount 10) */ SELECT B.COM_CODE AS BUYER, B.COL01_DATA AS ROW_CNT FROM BNTSLGDEF A, BNTSLGIMP B WHERE 1=1 AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN A.OPEN_DATE AND A.CLOSE_DATE AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN B.OPEN_DATE AND B.CLOSE_DATE AND A.SLG_ID = B.SLG_ID AND A.SLG_ID = 'P07-0000004' /* SLOGIC-END */ ) Y , ( /* SLOGIC-BEGIN(P07-0000005) 발주서 양식이 다름 ==팝업에 적용 하겠음 */ SELECT B.COM_CODE AS BUYER FROM BNTSLGDEF A, BNTSLGIMP B WHERE 1=1 AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN A.OPEN_DATE AND A.CLOSE_DATE AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN B.OPEN_DATE AND B.CLOSE_DATE AND A.SLG_ID = B.SLG_ID AND A.SLG_ID = 'P07-0000005' /* SLOGIC-END */ ) Z , ( /* SLOGIC-BEGIN(P06-0000043) 신용카드사용 코객사 */ SELECT B.COM_CODE BUYER FROM BNTSLGDEF A, BNTSLGIMP B WHERE 1=1 AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN A.OPEN_DATE AND A.CLOSE_DATE AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN B.OPEN_DATE AND B.CLOSE_DATE AND A.SLG_ID = B.SLG_ID AND A.SLG_ID = 'P06-0000043' --<-- P07-0000006 : ID 대체 /* SLOGIC-END */ ) V , ( /* SLOGIC-BEGIN(P07-0000008) 조회조건 */ SELECT B.COM_CODE AS BUYER , B.COL01_DATA AS DEPT_FIX , B.COL02_DATA AS PR_USER_FIX , B.COL03_DATA AS PO_USER_FIX FROM BNTSLGDEF A, BNTSLGIMP B WHERE 1=1 AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN A.OPEN_DATE AND A.CLOSE_DATE AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN B.OPEN_DATE AND B.CLOSE_DATE AND A.SLG_ID = B.SLG_ID AND A.SLG_ID = 'P07-0000008' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 'X' FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = #{user_id} AND USER_TYPE = 'A') /* SLOGIC-END */ ) W , ( /* SLOGIC-BEGIN(P07-0000016) 추가리포트버튼 */ SELECT B.COM_CODE AS BUYER , B.COL01_DATA AS BTN_TEXT , B.COL02_DATA AS REPORT_ID , B.COL03_DATA AS REPORT_URL FROM BNTSLGDEF A, BNTSLGIMP B WHERE 1=1 AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN A.OPEN_DATE AND A.CLOSE_DATE AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN B.OPEN_DATE AND B.CLOSE_DATE AND A.SLG_ID = B.SLG_ID AND A.SLG_ID = 'P07-0000016' /* SLOGIC-END */ ) A , ( /* SLOGIC-BEGIN(P07-0000017) 마감다운로드 기능 */ SELECT B.COM_CODE AS BUYER FROM BNTSLGDEF A, BNTSLGIMP B WHERE 1=1 AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN A.OPEN_DATE AND A.CLOSE_DATE AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN B.OPEN_DATE AND B.CLOSE_DATE AND A.SLG_ID = B.SLG_ID AND A.SLG_ID = 'P07-0000017' /* SLOGIC-END */ ) B WHERE X.BUYER = Y.BUYER(+) AND X.BUYER = Z.BUYER(+) AND X.BUYER = V.BUYER(+) AND X.BUYER = W.BUYER(+) AND X.BUYER = A.BUYER(+) AND X.BUYER = B.BUYER(+)

/*selectBuyerWmGrWarehousingLisProcessInfo*/ SELECT HD.PROCESS_TYPE , WMS.WAREHOUSE_CODE FROM ICOMPODT PO, ICOMPOHD HD, WMSIVDT WMS WHERE PO.BUYER = #{com_code} AND PO.PO_NO = #{po_no} AND PO.PO_SEQ = #{po_seq} AND PO.BUYER = HD.BUYER AND PO.PO_NO = HD.PO_NO AND PO.BUYER = WMS.BUYER(+) AND PO.PO_NO = WMS.PO_NO(+) AND PO.PO_SEQ = WMS.PO_SEQ(+) AND WMS.STATUS(+) <> 'D' AND PO.STATUS <> 'D' AND HD.STATUS <> 'D'

/* selectRefTotalList */ SELECT C.BUYER, C.REF_PR_NO, SUM(NVL(B.ITEM_AMT, 0)) AS PO_AMT, SUM(NVL(D.ITEM_AMT, 0)) AS GR_AMT, COUNT(NVL(B.PO_SEQ, 0)) AS PO_COUNT FROM ICOMPOHD A, ICOMPODT B, ICOMPRDT C, ICOMGRDT D WHERE 1=1 AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.PO_NO = B.PO_NO AND B.BUYER = C.BUYER AND B.PR_NO = C.PR_NO AND B.PR_SEQ = C.PR_SEQ AND B.PO_NO = D.PO_NO AND B.PO_SEQ = D.PO_SEQ AND B.BUYER = D.BUYER AND A.STATUS <> 'D' AND B.STATUS <> 'D' AND C.STATUS <> 'D' AND D.STATUS <> 'D' AND A.BUYER = #{st_coom_code} AND D.GR_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date} GROUP BY C.BUYER, C.REF_PR_NO
ORDER BY 3
ORDER BY 4
ORDER BY 2

/* selectBuyerWmGrWarehousingLockCheck */ SELECT NVL(COUNT(*), 0) AS YN_FLAG FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE 1=1 AND TYPE = 'NOGR' AND COMPANY_CODE = #{com_code} AND FLAG = 'Y' AND CODE = (SELECT SUBSTR(GR_DATE, 0, 6) FROM ICOMGRDT WHERE BUYER = #{com_code} AND GR_NO = #{gr_no} AND GR_SEQ = #{gr_seq} AND STATUS <> 'D')
